sourcePolicy.directQuotationLimit: Use only short, necessary quotations with exact attribution. Paraphrase copyrighted standards and proprietary guidance unless Obserra holds an applicable license.
sourcePolicy.examContentBoundary: Do not reproduce confidential PMP examination content, exam dumps, proprietary PMI item banks, or copyrighted courseware. Teach published objectives and use original Obserra questions and scenarios.
sourcePolicy.learnerCitationRequirement: Each lesson, video transcript, workbook exercise, AI tutor answer, and assessment rationale must cite the source identifiers that support substantive claims.

courseUse: Documented cost growth, schedule delay, technical risk, integration, testing, reserve, contractor, and oversight lessons.
